scope: Historical offline endpoint findings plus post-repair verification; no live cloud calls in this suite

fixture_corrections: Invalid voice syntax now has the exact HTTP 422 request-model contract; identical voices and semantic prosody errors retain HTTP 400.
Job polling is bounded at 45 seconds and controlled worker waits at 30 seconds; functional assertions were not relaxed.
Each system case loads an isolated API module after configuring its environment, so prior unit-test imports cannot retain different CORS or upload-limit startup settings.
Generated scratch files are ignored and removed after verification.
final_verification.note: The snapshot, observations and timing failures below are historical reproductions, not unresolved final failures. Request-case totals include polling and therefore vary between full runs.

commands.report: Set TACTIQ_AUDIT_REPORT_PATH before running to write the sanitized machine-readable endpoint matrix.
commands.focused_reproductions: Append -k with a selector below. Focused runs intentionally do not claim complete endpoint coverage.

matrix.note: Case verdicts include the entire pytest test outcome. Setup requests and job polling inside a failing test are conservatively marked failed even when their HTTP status assertion passed.

minimal_reproduction: Use a valid test-only credential with a lowercase, uppercase, or mixed-case bearer authentication scheme.
Exchange that credential for a browser session.
findings.expected: HTTP 200 for a valid credential; authentication schemes are case-insensitive.
findings.observed: HTTP 401 even though the shared authenticator already accepted the credential.
findings.suggested_fix: Parse the authorization scheme case-insensitively and reuse the validated principal while preserving header-over-cookie precedence.
findings.fixture_provenance: offline/fixture authentication digests and real TestClient lifespan

minimal_reproduction: Authenticate with a valid test-only credential.
Supply a resource identifier beginning with whitespace, or one containing 257 characters.
findings.expected: A bounded client error: HTTP 400, 404, or 422.
findings.observed: HTTP 500 from uncaught runtime identifier validation.
findings.suggested_fix: Validate path identifiers before storage access and translate RecordValidationError into a client response without weakening unknown-ID tenant isolation.
findings.fixture_provenance: offline/fixture authentication and real isolated SQLite storage

minimal_reproduction: Create and populate an isolated match with real scenario events.
Request narration or dual commentary with an explicitly empty insight identifier.
findings.expected: HTTP 400 or 422 for an explicitly invalid identifier.
findings.observed: HTTP 200; the empty selection silently becomes the latest insight.
findings.suggested_fix: Require a nonempty insight identifier when the optional field is supplied; retain omitted/null selection as the documented latest-insight behavior.
findings.fixture_provenance: offline/fixture real scenario insights and disabled Foundry fallback

minimal_reproduction: Submit a link containing an unmatched IPv6-host bracket.
No DNS lookup, socket, or download is needed.
findings.observed: HTTP 500 because urlparse raises before the handler's ValueError translation.
findings.suggested_fix: Perform URL parsing inside the validation try/except, or validate the link at the request-model boundary.
findings.fixture_provenance: offline/fixture malformed-link input with outbound network guards

minimal_reproduction: Supply nonempty bytes that are not a video container through upload or a fixture download.
For asynchronous processing, submit the same invalid media and poll the real durable job runner.
findings.expected: Synchronous HTTP 400, or an asynchronous failed job without a successful match result.
findings.observed: Synchronous HTTP 200 and asynchronous succeeded status with a completed synthetic match.
findings.important_qualification: The synthetic fallback is explicitly labelled. The finding is that invalid user media receives the success-shaped video-analysis contract, not that synthetic provenance is hidden.
findings.suggested_fix: Reject invalid video containers before match creation. Keep clearly labelled extraction fallbacks only for decodable video if that fallback remains an approved product feature.
findings.fixture_provenance: offline/fixture invalid bytes, fixture download, and real isolated durable jobs

minimal_reproduction: Have the CV event-extraction adapter raise ValueError.
Read the replay for the resulting explicitly labelled synthetic fallback.
findings.expected: processed_until_ms and every replay frame timestamp are bounded by the playable source duration.

observed.qualification: The exact synthetic timestamp varies with encoded fixture bytes.

findings.suggested_fix: Do not attach unrelated synthetic scenario timestamps to real media. Reject unavailable analysis or explicitly produce a source-bounded fallback timeline.
findings.fixture_provenance: offline/fixture generated MP4, real FFmpeg normalization, and injected CV-adapter failure

minimal_reproduction: Create a match in each of two isolated test tenants.
Fault-inject the first match's persisted video_source association to the second match's generated source file.
Evict and restore the first match, then request its source as its own tenant's viewer.
findings.expected: HTTP 404 for a source outside the requested match's media directory.
findings.observed: HTTP 200 serving the foreign match's media because only the global source root is checked.
findings.important_qualification: This requires corrupted or wrongly associated persisted metadata. Ordinary foreign-match HTTP and WebSocket requests are correctly denied by the tested authentication boundary.
findings.suggested_fix: Resolve the allowed source root as source_root / match_id and verify the file belongs to that match after symlink resolution.
findings.fixture_provenance: offline/fixture generated video, real SQLite restore, and explicit persisted-association fault injection

minimal_reproduction: Create isolated matches belonging to different tenants.
Place a test-only clip symlink in the first match's clip directory pointing to a generated clip in the other match's directory.
Mark the first clip association ready and request it as the first tenant.
findings.expected: HTTP 404 because the resolved file does not belong to the requested match.
findings.observed: HTTP 200 because the resolved path remains under the global clips root.
findings.important_qualification: This requires local filesystem manipulation, not a demonstrated ability for an API viewer to create symlinks. The fixture symlink is always removed.
findings.suggested_fix: Validate against clips_root / match_id after resolution and reject symlink media entries consistently with deletion policy.
findings.fixture_provenance: offline/fixture generated video and explicit isolated cross-match symlink

historical_timing_budget_failures.expected: The fixture job finishes within the 12-second polling budget.
historical_timing_budget_failures.observed: Polling exceeded 12 seconds. Read-only inspection of the isolated database after lifespan shutdown showed the job succeeded in 15.36 seconds.
historical_timing_budget_failures.qualification: No test was rerun and no timeout was relaxed. The preceding complete run passed this case.
historical_timing_budget_failures.unreached_assertions: This case did not reach its replay/result/finished-cancel assertions; other fixtures still provide passing positive coverage for every declared operation.

historical_timing_budget_failures.expected: The worker reaches the controlled CV adapter within the five-second fixture wait.
historical_timing_budget_failures.observed: The five-second wait expired before the adapter was reached. The finally block released the adapter; the isolated durable job subsequently succeeded in 9.39 seconds.
historical_timing_budget_failures.qualification: No test was rerun and no timeout was relaxed. The preceding complete run passed queued/running cancellation and queue-capacity cleanup.
historical_timing_budget_failures.unreached_assertions: The final run did not reach queued/running cancellation or queue-capacity rejection within this case.

verified_contract_areas: All declared route/method pairs have exercised cases and passing positive cases.
Every declared HTTP operation has explicit anonymous admission; protected operations reject invalid credentials.
Viewer, analyst, administrator, wrong-tenant, and unknown-resource policies.
Secure cookie exchange, logout, verified Origin requirements, and header-over-cookie precedence.
Scenario start, idempotent start, pause, resume, completion, restart conflict, deletion, and lifespan cleanup.
Synchronous upload/link and asynchronous events/CV flows with generated video and explicit adapter fixtures.
Missing and invalid model setup, extractor failures, durable failure status, running/queued cancellation, and queue-capacity cleanup pass the repaired combined full suite.
Private source/clip retrieval, bounded/suffix/open/multiple byte ranges, malformed and unsatisfiable ranges, and If-Range behavior.
Overlays, persisted viewer profiles, real scenario insights, all seven narrative locales, audiences, guardrails, recaps, and commentary audit limits.
Missing Speech configuration, all seven fixture speech locales, SSML escaping, invalid voices/prosody, dual-voice composition, and provider faults.
Health, metrics, SLO status, Prometheus, body limits, request correlation, HTTP admission capacity, and request rate limits.
WebSocket state/insight snapshots, service broadcasts, cookie/bearer/origin admission, missing/foreign IDs, subscriber capacity, deletion pins, and disconnect cleanup.
Authenticated GET/HEAD documentation and schema plus CORS OPTIONS preflights.
Machine-report sanitization and explicit failure of incomplete operation coverage.
coverage_limitations: No live Foundry, Azure Speech, external-video-host, or real CV model-quality validation was attempted.
Fixture credentials, adapter outputs, generated media, and metadata/filesystem faults are not evidence of real-match model quality or ordinary remote exploitability.
Durability is exercised through real SQLite and same-process cache restore, not process-crash or multi-host failover testing.
The historical baseline had two bounded fixture-budget failures; the corrected bounded fixtures now pass without relaxing functional assertions.
This checked-in summary preserves historical reproductions. The final machine matrix and JUnit artifacts record the authoritative passing combined run.
